steps: A proposer sends Prepare with a unique ballot 7.
A quorum promises not to accept lower ballots and returns prior accepted values.
The proposer selects the required value and sends Accept for ballot 7.
A quorum accepts it, making that value chosen for the slot.

lesson.scenario: A proposer chooses one configuration value through three durable Paxos acceptors.

steps.title: Empty slot
steps.narration: No acceptor has promised or accepted a value for slot 12.
steps.outcome: The slot has no chosen value.
steps.invariant: A value is chosen only after acceptance by a quorum.

steps.title: Prepare quorum
steps.narration: P sends prepare 7 and receives promises from A1 and A2.
steps.outcome: A majority promises not to accept lower ballots.
steps.invariant: An acceptor persists its promise before replying.

steps.title: Safe value selected
steps.narration: No promise reports an earlier accepted value, so P may propose blue.
steps.outcome: The proposed value obeys the phase-one selection rule.
steps.invariant: If promises include accepted values, the proposer must use the value from the highest accepted ballot.

steps.title: Majority acceptance
steps.narration: A2 durably accepts ballot 7 value blue.
steps.outcome: Blue is chosen by the intersecting quorum A1,A2.
steps.invariant: Once chosen, every later successful ballot must preserve blue.

steps.title: Learner notified
steps.narration: Accepted messages allow L to learn blue while A3 remains behind.
steps.outcome: The decision survives one acceptor failure.
steps.invariant: Learner notification may lag without changing the chosen value.

production.scenario: A managed DNS platform uses a Paxos-backed control plane to choose exactly one signed zone package before authoritative name servers pick up a delegation change.
components: Lets an SRE publish a new signed zone for customer vanity domains
Validates the new zone package and owns rollout state
Runs the quorum protocol that chooses one committed zone package for each zone serial
Authoritative signed records and SOA serial for the zone
Serve the committed zone package to resolvers worldwide
Submits the previous signed package if monitoring spots a bad publish
flows: The SRE pushes a new signed delegation set for a customer domain through the rollout console.
propose signed zone package for serial 2026-09-21-17
The control API asks the Paxos quorum to pick this exact package as the next committed version.
Only the package that wins the quorum write becomes the authoritative zone blob for that serial.
serve next SOA serial and records
Name servers poll the package store and start answering with the newly chosen zone after commit.
If monitors detect a broken delegation path, the rollback controller sees it from the live name-server fleet.
Rollback goes back through the same Paxos-protected path so the revert is also a single chosen decision.
